scope: Internal research/education orientation QA only. Not clinical validation.

meshProvenance.transformConvention: SimpleITK LPS physical millimetres -> centre on gland centroid -> scale to metres for GLB. Viewer convention: +x patient-left, +y posterior, +z superior/base.

notes: The lesion is midline, anterior and basal on the source label affine.
The regenerated GLB lesion centroid is midline, anterior and basal under the documented viewer convention.
The default 3D viewer uses axial MRI-style projection: anterior screen-top, posterior screen-bottom, patient right screen-left, patient left screen-right.
